text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper reports a national-scale spatial implementation covering the entire Taiwan island (~35,808 sq.km). The primary focus is on LULC prediction/simulation, analyzing past decadal changes (1990–2020) and projecting future LULC for 2030 and 2050 under four different scenarios. The methodology integrates Support Vector Machine classification with Markov Chain modeling, providing spatially explicit LULC maps. Quantitative accuracy metrics are reported, including overall accuracy (~0.87) and kappa (~0.74) for classification and simulation validation. Multiple scenarios are compared quantitatively. The outputs include detailed mapped LULC projections. The study is not a review, not limited to local or regional scale, and includes future projections beyond a single scenario. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
